Record each individual flow's information
For the IP address, it's recorded in format of Hex-INT:
e.g. 10.0.6.1 -> 0b.00.06.01 -> 0b000601
For the [flow should last for] time, it is calculated by [flow data size] / bandwidth
There might be some error since the processing have delay, 
but comparing it with [flow last for], you can infer how much slower does this flow run, compare to ideal case.

[Sender IP] [Receiver IP] [Sender Port] [Receiver Port] [flow data size] [flow start at] [flow last for] [flow should last for] 
0b000601 0b000701 10000 100 2000000 10010 2029130 1682400
0b000701 0b000001 10000 100 2000000 10010 2029130 1682400
0b000001 0b000101 10000 100 2000000 10011 2029129 1682400
0b000101 0b000201 10000 100 2000000 10010 2029130 1682400
